records.title: SBI Ripple Asia completes conceptual proof of tokenized deposits and deposit-type digital money using XRPL
records.summary: SBI Ripple Asia announced a conceptual proof for lower-cost tokenized deposits and deposit-type digital money using SBI's MoneyTap domestic transfer infrastructure, its token issuance platform and the XRP Ledger as the contemplated blockchain. The company says the work focuses on feasibility within existing bank infrastructure and future social implementation.
records.limitations: The announcement describes a conceptual proof, not a production deployment, live deposit balance or executed payment volume. It does not establish that the native XRP asset is used as collateral or bridge currency in this deposit-token design.

records.title: SBI Ripple Asia corporate profile and ownership disclosure as of March 31, 2026
records.summary: SBI Holdings' group-company profile describes SBI Ripple Asia as a joint venture between SBI Holdings and Ripple. It reports SBI Group voting-rights ownership of 60% as of March 31, 2026 and describes the venture's RippleNet/DLT business across Japan, Korea and parts of Southeast Asia.
records.limitations: The 60% figure is SBI Group voting-rights ownership in SBI Ripple Asia, not SBI ownership of Ripple Labs. The profile's RippleNet activity does not establish that every payment uses XRP.

records.publisher: SBI Remit / SBI VC Trade / SBI Ripple Asia
records.title: SBI Remit expands XRP-based Ripple international remittance to Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia
records.summary: SBI's September 6, 2023 release says SBI Remit would expand its XRP-based Ripple remittance service to bank accounts in the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia. It describes SBI VC Trade sending XRP in real time in response to remittance requests and Tranglo as the overseas payout partner converting to local fiat. The release says SBI Remit had used Ripple's payments network since 2017 and had introduced XRP as a bridge asset for Philippines remittance in 2021.
records.limitations: This is a 2023 launch/expansion announcement, not a 2026 volume disclosure. Current corridor activity, transaction count, XRP turnover, market-maker inventory and share of total remittance are unknown.

records.title: SBI VC Trade reports two million registered accounts
records.summary: SBI VC Trade reports that registered service accounts exceeded two million as of July 6, 2026. The release describes its crypto trading, stablecoin and campaign services.
records.limitations: Registered accounts are not active users, unique funded accounts, XRP holders, XRP balances or trading volume. No XRP-specific customer or flow breakdown is provided.

records.title: SBI START tokenized bond with XRP subscription benefit
records.summary: SBI Holdings' first security-token bond was issued at JPY 10 billion, three-year term and 2.15% annual coupon; SBI Securities reports the offering sold out. Eligible domestic investors purchasing at least JPY 100,000 and completing SBI VC Trade account procedures were offered an initial XRP benefit equivalent to JPY 200 per JPY 100,000 subscribed. The product page says the initial benefit was to be distributed by May 15, 2026. Later interest-date XRP benefits were undecided as of the February 20 disclosure and are not guaranteed. The bond is issued/managed on BOOSTRY's ibet for Fin platform, not XRPL.
records.limitations: The JPY 10B is bond principal, not XRP investment. Actual eligible subscription amount, XRP quantity distributed and source of XRP inventory are not disclosed. The product page says future coupon-date benefits were not determined; do not treat them as promised recurring XRP purchases.

records.publisher: SBI Shinsei Bank / SBI VC Trade
records.title: SBI Shinsei Bank six-month yen deposit campaign with XRP exchange coupon
records.summary: SBI Shinsei Bank and SBI VC Trade announced a February 2-March 31, 2026 campaign awarding XRP exchange coupons worth up to JPY 20,000 based on eligible six-month yen time deposits of at least JPY 300,000. The deposit rate was 0.70% pre-tax. The campaign is an XRP acquisition incentive tied to a traditional bank deposit.
records.limitations: The campaign period has ended. Actual deposit uptake, eligible balance, coupon redemption and XRP quantity distributed are not disclosed. A coupon is not evidence of an open-market XRP purchase.

records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI Shinsei Trust Bank / SBI VC Trade / Startale
records.title: SBI Group and Startale launch JPYSC trust-backed yen stablecoin
records.summary: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank is the JPYSC issuer, SBI VC Trade distributes it and Startale Group co-developed it. Initial availability was restricted to SBI VC Trade account balances; the release says public-chain circulation would follow once relevant legal and tax practice is clarified. The structure is trust-backed and designed for large-value corporate use.
records.limitations: The June launch did not establish public-chain transfers or an Arc/StableFX route. JPYSC is distinct from JPYC and from USD stablecoins USDC/RLUSD. No actual payment, collateral or lending volume is reported in the launch release.

records.publisher: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank / SBI VC Trade
records.title: JPYSC reserve update: JGB investment and lending applications
records.summary: SBI's September 7 update reports approximately JPY 20.1B JPYSC issued, approximately JPY 1B of trust assets allocated to Japanese government bonds and approximately JPY 6.9B in lending applications. The JGB allocation is an actual reserve-asset allocation; lending applications are not completed loans or deployed collateral.
records.limitations: The figures are dated September 7, not a current October 30 reserve snapshot. The JPY 6.9B represents applications, not approved or funded loans. No public-chain circulation or XRP collateral use is established.

records.title: SBI VC Trade RLUSD product terms: Ethereum-only chain support and transfer limits at launch
records.summary: SBI VC Trade's product terms specify Ethereum-chain RLUSD only at launch, free deposits and withdrawals 24/7 except maintenance, a JPY-equivalent 1,000,000 withdrawal limit per transaction and separate daily deposit limits. The same announcement says USDC had been available since March 2025.
records.limitations: No XRPL RLUSD deposit/withdrawal route through SBI is established at launch. No RLUSD balance, turnover, collateral use or market flow is disclosed.
